title: Potato and Leek Soup
summary: Goated winter soup recipe by he who shall not be named...
extendedSummary: Goated winter soup recipe by he who shall not be named. It's also pretty low effort (just takes a long time to simmer), pretty cheap, and has not many ingredients at all... so it's super easy. Just requires a blender or handblender of some sort.
method: Melt butter in saucepan, add chopped onions, soften, then add chopped leek
Peel and chop potatoes and add to saucepan
Simmer slowly for a further 1/2 hour
For the cheesy toast, set oven to 200°C, and layout toast on a pan, butter toast, add cheeses, and sprinkle some oregano over the top
Cook for 10 mins or until golden brown and a bit cripsy
